mapper.select:
select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, sec.Sec_Tenderee as tendereeId, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, scp.Cp_Rate as cpRate, scp.Cp_Describe as cpDescribe, c7.C_Name as wnWinUnitName,
wn.* from Sec_Win_Notice wn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=wn.Sec_Id left join Sec_Control_Price scp on sec.Sec_Id=scp.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select Cp_Id from Sec_Control_Price where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and Cp_State=7 order by Cp_Create_Time desc limit 1) left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_Id=wn.Wn_Win_Unit left join Sec_Document sd on wn.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select D_Id from Sec_Document where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and D_State=7 order by D_Create_Time desc limit 1) where wn.Sec_Id=#{secId} and wn.Wn_State=7 order by wn.Wn_State_Time desc limit 1

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, scp.Cp_Rate as cpRate, scp.Cp_Describe as cpDescribe, c7.C_Name as wnWinUnitName,
wn.* from Sec_Win_Notice wn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=wn.Sec_Id left join Sec_Control_Price scp on sec.Sec_Id=scp.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select Cp_Id from Sec_Control_Price where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and Cp_State=7 order by Cp_Create_Time desc limit 1) left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_Id=wn.Wn_Win_Unit left join Sec_Document sd on wn.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select D_Id from Sec_Document where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and D_State=7 order by D_Create_Time desc limit 1) where wn.Sec_Id IN
#{id}
order by wn.Wn_State_Time desc

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, sec.Sec_Determin_Type as secDeterminType, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, c7.C_Name as wnWinUnitName, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, scp.Cp_Rate as cpRate, scp.Cp_Describe as cpDescribe, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId,
wn.* from Sec_Win_Notice wn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=wn.Sec_Id left join Sec_Control_Price scp on sec.Sec_Id=scp.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select Cp_Id from Sec_Control_Price where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and Cp_State=7 order by Cp_Create_Time desc limit 1) left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_ID=wn.Wn_Win_Unit left join Sys_file sf on sf.FileId=wn.Wn_Id left join Sec_Document sd on wn.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id and scp.Cp_Id=(select D_Id from Sec_Document where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and D_State=7 order by D_Create_Time desc limit 1) where wn.Wn_Id=#{wnId}
select c.C_Name as wuCompanyName, c.C_Abbreviation as wuCompAbbName, wu.* from Sec_Win_Unit wu left join Sys_Company c on c.C_Id = wu.Wu_Company_Id where wu.Wn_Id = #{wnId}

sql.if: and mn.Wn_Id in ( select swu.Wn_Id from Sec_Win_Unit swu left join Sys_Company com on swu.Wu_Company_Id=com.C_Id where com.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.cName},'%') )

and mn.Wn_Id in ( select swu1.Wn_Id from Sec_Win_Unit swu1 left join Sys_Company comy on swu1.Wu_Company_Id=comy.C_Id
where likeCname(#{params.secWinUnits},comy.c_id)=true
where comy.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.secWinUnits},'%')
)
and mn.sec_id in (select spro.sec_id from Sec_Project spro where spro.p_id=#{params.pId})

mapper.select: select count(1) from Sec_Win_Notice mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id where 1=1
select count(1) from Sec_Win_Notice mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id where 1=1
mapper.sql: (select sd.D_Name from Pre_Project pro left join Sec_Project sp on pro.P_Id = sp.P_Id left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where sd.D_Name is not null and sp.Sec_Id = wn.Sec_Id limit 1) as pCompetentDepartmentName,

(select wm_concat(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select string_agg(P_Id,',') from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select GROUP_CONCAT(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.select: select ${selectClause} from Sec_Win_Notice mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre on dpre.D_Id = pre.p_Competent_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join (select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists (select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time)) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id
select mn.Bid_WInner as cId, mn.Tender_Price as price from Sec_Calibration_Report mn where mn.State = 7 and mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} order by mn.Create_Time desc limit 1

select mn.C_Id as cId, mn.Erd_Price as price from Sec_Eval_Report_Dtl mn left join Sec_Eval_Report mer on mn.Er_ID=mer.Er_Id where mer.Er_State = 7 and mer.Sec_Id = #{secId} order by mn.Erd_Sort asc limit 1
